goal: Generate a 7-day lookbook infographic suitable for posting on Xiaohongshu/Instagram, in 3:4 format.

title_block.main_title: What to wear for a week · Inspiration from the era tour series
title_block.subtitle: 7 days · sequins & knits

subject.model: Young woman with long golden curly hair, features with an original anime feel leaning towards realism, not pursuing pixel-level consistency with any real person; body is proportionately slender
subject.consistency: In 7 boxes, the same person with the same face shape and hairstyle

layout.format: Top 4 grids + bottom 3 grids misaligned, with 8px hairline spacing between grids

panel_design.label_top: DAY 1 / MON to SUN in uppercase, small font in corner
panel_design.outfit_caption: At the bottom edge of each grid a short English style name + 4 to 6 characters in Chinese

outfits.label: MON
outfits.style: Sequin short top + high-waisted wide-leg black pants + stiletto boots, with a reflective stage background.

outfits.label: TUE
outfits.style: Cream white chunky knit cardigan + denim flared pants + brown leather belt, warm indoor window light.

outfits.label: WED
outfits.style: Wine red velvet mini skirt + over-the-knee boots, in front of the theater curtain.

outfits.label: THU
outfits.style: Black and white striped T + khaki Bermuda shorts + vintage sneakers, urban street style

outfits.label: FRI
outfits.style: Dark green silk shirt + black straight-leg trousers + small pocket square, light formal dinner scene

outfits.label: SAT
outfits.style: Plaid mini dress + denim jacket tied at the waist + white sneakers, park lawn.

outfits.label: SUN
outfits.style: Gray hooded sweatshirt + soft pants + wool socks at home, small coffee cup prop, relaxed feel

style.art_style: Japanese miscellaneous fashion flat lay + beige seamless paper + light post-production grain
style.color_palette: Off-white, black, gold accents, low saturation red and green

footer.summary: A hint of glitter on weekdays, returning to knits and soft materials on weekends

must_keep: In 7 boxes, the same person is recognizable, with obvious clothing differences that do not repeat
Each grid has a full body or knee-up body, without cropping the head
The main color palette does not include fluorescent green.
avoid: The small text inside the framework exceeds two lines.
